# Command Center

<!-- Generated by `pnpm cc:gen` from apps/cli/src (07 §8). Do not edit by hand. -->

Command Center - decisions, action items and meeting rhythm across your workstreams. You work with it through `cc-axi`, its command line for agents. Output is TOON on stdout, errors included; add `--format json` only for scripts.

## Start here

Run `cc-axi` with no arguments. The home view shows what is live now:

- `bin, description`: where `cc-axi` is, and what Command Center is
- `workspace, now`: the workspace and its local time
- `today`: today's meetings: ref, time, meeting
- `attention`: counts of overdue, at-risk and awaiting-review items, pending confirmations and browser sessions that need the user
- `items, count`: the most urgent items (ref, title, due, state) out of all due within 7 days
- `help`: the next commands to run

Then:

- Run `cc-axi` with no arguments for the home view.
- Run `cc-axi <command> --help` for its flags and examples.
- Confirming, accepting, dropping, deciding and approving are done by the user in the app.

Item refs look like `A-0142`, decisions `D-0008`, issues `I-0012`, measures `K-0003` and meetings `M-0031`. Lists show 50 rows unless `--limit` says otherwise, with a `count:` line of shown and total, and `help:` lines that name the next command.

## Commands

### home

- `cc-axi home`: The home view: today's meetings, attention counts and the most urgent items.

### items

- `cc-axi items list [--workstream <slug>] [--owner <me|person>] [--state <lifecycle|active>] [--health <health>] [--due-before <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--fields <list>] [--limit <n>]`: List action items.
- `cc-axi items view <ref> [--full]`: Show one action item.
- `cc-axi items create --workstream <slug> --title "<verb + deliverable>" --due <YYYY-MM-DD> --done-means "<text>" [--owner <person>] [--evidence "<requirement>"...] [--kind <todo|follow_up>] [--meeting <M-ref>]`: Create an action item as a draft for the user to accept.
- `cc-axi items update <ref> [--health <health>] [--note "<text>"] [--propose-due <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--reason "<text>"]`: Set an item's health with a note, or propose a new due date with a reason.
- `cc-axi items claim <ref> [--evidence <url|file:<path>|record:<binding>/<type>/<externalId>>...] [--note "<text>"]`: Claim an item as done with evidence; the user confirms it in the app.
- `cc-axi items attach <ref> --evidence <url|file:<path>|record:<binding>/<type>/<externalId>> [--requirement <er-id>]`: Attach one piece of evidence to an item.
- `cc-axi items history <ref> [--limit <n>]`: An item's changes with their actors, oldest first.

### search

- `cc-axi search "<text>" [--types <list>] [--limit <n>]`: Full-text search over items, decisions, issues and meetings.

### decisions

- `cc-axi decisions list [--workstream <slug>] [--status <status>] [--limit <n>]`: List decisions.
- `cc-axi decisions view <ref>`: Show one decision.
- `cc-axi decisions propose --workstream <slug> --question "<q>" [--option "<text>"...] [--decider <person>] [--reversibility <two_way|one_way>] [--due-by <YYYY-MM-DD>]`: Propose a decision as a question with options; its decider decides in the app.

### issues

- `cc-axi issues list [--workstream <slug>] [--status <status>] [--limit <n>]`: List issues.
- `cc-axi issues view <ref>`: Show one issue.
- `cc-axi issues raise --workstream <slug> --title "<text>"`: Raise an issue for its workstream's next issues section.

### measures

- `cc-axi measures list [--workstream <slug>] [--limit <n>]`: List scorecard measures with their targets and latest values.
- `cc-axi measures record <ref> --value <v> [--period <YYYY-MM-DD>] [--note "<t>"]`: Record a manual measure value for a period, by default the current one.

### goals

- `cc-axi goals list [--workstream <slug>] [--period <current|previous|next>] [--limit <n>]`: List goals of the current, previous or next period.

### workstreams

- `cc-axi workstreams list [--limit <n>]`: List the workstreams of the workspace.
- `cc-axi workstreams view <slug>`: Show one workstream.

### onboarding

- `cc-axi onboarding status`: Where onboarding stands: the steps answered, the next one, and the app-only answers.
- `cc-axi onboarding recommend --file <profile.json>`: Run the framework recommender on a profile.json (01 §6): one recommendation per workstream.
- `cc-axi onboarding apply --file <profile.json> [--dry-run]`: Set up the workspace from a profile.json; --dry-run previews every record and writes nothing.
- `cc-axi onboarding export --out <profile.json>`: Write the answers as a profile.json to commit: no records, secrets or person names (01 §9.1).

### setup

- `cc-axi setup hooks [--agents <list>] [--scope <user|project>]`: Install or repair the SessionStart hooks that run `cc-axi hook session-start` in new agent sessions.
- `cc-axi setup status`: Show which agents have the SessionStart hook, at user and project scope.

### hook

- `cc-axi hook session-start`: What an installed hook prints at session start: today's meetings, attention counts and the top items of this directory's workstream.

### mcp

- `cc-axi mcp`: The stdio MCP server (07 §7): 14 tools over the local API as --principal; register it with `claude mcp add command-center -- cc-axi mcp --principal <name>`.

### update

- `cc-axi update [--check]`: Report the cc-axi version; cc-axi ships inside the Command Center app and updates with it.

Flags come after the command. Every command also takes `--format <toon|json>` (output format; json is an escape for scripts), `--principal <name>` (the agent principal to call as; its token is in run/tokens of the profile), and `--help` for its flags, defaults and examples.

## Rules

- The user does these in the app, never an agent: accept, approve, attest, confirm, decide, deny, drop, reject. A command that needs the user returns `pending_confirmation` or `E_HUMAN_REQUIRED` with a deep link; tell the user, and do not look for another way.
- Items you create are drafts until the user accepts them. A claim needs evidence (a URL, `file:<path>` or `record:<binding>/<type>/<externalId>`); the user verifies it.
- Errors print `error:`, `code:` and `help:` on stdout. Exit 1 is an error, exit 2 a usage error (`E_USAGE`, `E_UNKNOWN_FLAG`): read the help line and fix the command. A repeated mutation prints `status: no-op` and exits 0.
- `E_APP_NOT_RUNNING` means the Command Center app is closed: ask the user to open it.
- `--principal <name>` (or `$CC_PRINCIPAL`) names the agent principal you act as; the user grants its scopes and workstreams in the app.

## Ambient context

With the user's go-ahead, `cc-axi setup hooks` installs a SessionStart hook for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode (`--scope project` for one repository). Each new session then starts with `cc-axi hook session-start`: today's meetings, the attention counts and the top items of the workstream mapped to the current directory. `cc-axi setup status` shows what is installed.
